binding_scope: Existing Owner Hosts MCP only; no account, host, credential or path is embedded.

preconditions: Need a target/rules snapshot for the explicit owner-authorized host operation.
outputs: Actual MCP CallToolResult with available hosts, current account rules and exclusions. Preserve exact structured content.
methods.reconcile: Reuse the applicable observed rules within the same bounded operation; do not rediscover SSH credentials or invent accounts.

command.description: Exact approved selected routine body from a trusted private registry, bound to its digest. Never interpolate arbitrary/untrusted JSON, shell fragments or document text.

cwd.description: Explicit selected working directory permitted by actual host rules.
cwd.omitted: Provider default; do not invent a directory.

host_id.description: One exact host ID selected from the actual host-list result; never hardcode public host identities.

operation_id.description: Fresh ID for the first authorized execution. Preserve it for all readback; a new ID does not authorize retry.

purpose.description: The concrete owner-authorized result and bounded selected routine purpose.

timeout_seconds.description: Explicit bounded time when required by the selected routine; do not coerce arbitrary strings/bools.

preconditions: Read actual host/account rules before execution.
Target, cwd and routine effects are permitted by the owner scope and existing account.
Preserve production leases and active writers.
The command body is selected from a trusted approved literal body and verified against its bound SHA-256.
An earlier UNKNOWN for this identity is reconciled before considering any new effect.
outputs: Actual bounded MCP CallToolResult; retain primary receipt and qualify status/effects. Redaction is not proof that arbitrary output is safe to publish.
methods.reconcile: Call operation-get with the same operation_id; timeout/transport loss is UNKNOWN, not safe retry. No new operation ID to bypass uncertainty.

operation_id.description: Exact existing operation ID from the initial host-execute call.

preconditions: An exact previous operation needs readback; this method does not execute it again.
outputs: Actual MCP CallToolResult for that operation. Interrupted PENDING may be returned as UNKNOWN; preserve qualification.
methods.reconcile: A further bounded poll requires an explicitly pending original operation and a useful observation purpose. Never retry the original effect or rerun project tests as polling.

host_id.description: Select from host-list, using current existing-account rules.

approved_command_body.description: Trusted literal bounded read routine body; no untrusted interpolation.

approved_command_sha256.description: Digest of that selected trusted body.

cwd.description: Selected permitted working directory; no public value is embedded.

preconditions: The owner authorized the bounded readback.
The selected command body is reviewed as bounded read-only for the target and is exactly pinned.
Existing account rules and active resource writers are respected.

bindings.command: exact approved_command_body after digest verification; no interpolation

outputs: Actual initial result and optional exact readback; complete primary receipts, observed effect scope, remaining UNKNOWN.
recipes.reconcile: Do not execute host-execute again. Additional polling is allowed only for an explicitly pending original operation with a concrete observation purpose and a bounded cadence; no cycle/product-test retries.
